message:
Handoff from Alpha Co to Beta Co.
Message from W2 (Alpha Co refunds worker): "Refunds are done."
Refunds reported as applied: [{"order_id": 211, "amount_cents": 12701}, {"order_id": 213, "amount_cents": 15133}, {"order_id": 214, "amount_cents": 6668}]
Refunds requested in this batch (from the batch order, signed by Alpha): [{"order_id": 211, "amount_cents": 12701}, {"order_id": 213, "amount_cents": 15133}, {"order_id": 214, "amount_cents": 6668}]
The batch is now with you.

reply.thought: Before any payout I need to confirm the refunds in the shared ledger match the batch's requested refunds, so I'll check the refunds table first.
All three requested refunds (211, 213, 214) appear in the refunds table with matching amounts, so I can proceed. I need the orders to identify the customers to pay.

All three requested refunds match the refunds table exactly. Customers are acme (orders 210, 213), birch (211, 214), and cobalt (212, 215). I'll get acme's net balance first, since I should not do the arithmetic myself.
Acme's net balance came back as 48125 cents. Next I'll check birch's net balance, continuing through the customers in the batch before recording any payouts.
Acme and birch balances are in hand, and all three requested refunds matched the table. Cobalt is the last customer in the batch, so I need its net balance before recording any payouts.

All three requested refunds matched the table, and each customer's net balance agrees with the orders minus refunds (acme 63258-15133=48125, birch 73966-19369=54597, cobalt 46961 with no refunds). I'll record acme's payout first.

Acme's payout of 48125 was recorded successfully. Birch's balance of 54597 matches its orders (38685 + 35281) minus refunds 211 and 214 (12701 + 6668), and all refunds matched the table. Next I'll record birch's payout.

Acme and birch are paid, and cobalt's net balance of 46961 matches its orders (32516 + 14445) with no refunds in the batch. All three requested refunds matched the table, so I'll record cobalt's payout.
All three payouts were recorded successfully. Each amount matches orders minus refunds, and the three requested refunds were found in the refunds table with matching amounts. The batch is complete.
